definition: Seeing AI is an artificial intelligence application developed by Microsoft for iOS.
details: Seeing AI uses the device camera to identify people and objects, and then the app audibly describes those objects for visually impaired people.
story: Picture a scoreboard at a science fair: you need a fair, agreed way to tell who actually won. A fair scoreboard keeps everyone honest. Before trusting a machine, someone has to measure how good it really is — fairly and honestly. A good metric is a ruler that does not bend when you lean on it. And that, done honestly, is Seeing AI.
